title: Rav Yehudah bar Ishtata
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.52a.17) he brings Rav Natan bar Ishaya a basket of fruit, on a festival. As he is leaving, Rav Natan lets him descend a step before telling him, “Lodge here,” that is, stay here overnight; the next day he leaves early. The Arukh, under Ashtita, explains it as a personal name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Eruvin gives Rav Natan bar Oshaya. Hyman gives Ishaya, adds that it happened on a festival, and explains the instruction as staying the night.
Hyman cites the Arukh under Ashtita, a different form from Ishtata.
